title: Hatya: The Murder
desc: Ravi's father, Ratan, gets killed when he refuses to sell his land to Murugan, a wealthy businessman. Later, Ravi sets out to avenge the death of his father.

title: Hogi Pyar Ki Jeet
desc: Two brothers attempt to fulfil their dying father's wish by marrying two daughters of an old enemy, intending to exact revenge.

title: Aarzoo
desc: After her fiancé, Vijay is killed in a crash, a pregnant Pooja agrees to marry Amar, her childhood friend. However, her life takes yet another turn when Vijay returns to her life.

title: Khal Nayak
desc: Inspector Ram succeeds in nabbing notorious criminal Ballu. When Ballu's escape taints Ram's name, his fiancée, Ganga, decides to trap Ballu. But, things get complicated when Ballu starts liking her.

title: Aranmanai 4
desc: Suspicious about his sister's death, Saravanan, a lawyer, tries to solve the mystery behind it, only to discover a mysteriously dark force at play.
